body.name: \(\mathfrak M_{n,K,d,\tau}\)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{n,K,d,\tau}=\{\mathfrak m=(\mathbf G,\boldsymbol\kappa,\mathbf q,\mathbf w):\ \mathcal G_\ell\text{ is a DAG for every }\ell\in L,\ \mathbf w\text{ has positive coordinates summing to one},\ (P_\ell,P_{\ell,I},P_I,\Delta,\mathcal G_{\mathrm m,I})\text{ are the induced objects fixed by the preceding constructions},\ P_I\text{ is simultaneously I-mixture faithful for every }I\subseteq V,\ \max_{t\in V}|\operatorname{pa}_{\cup}(t)|\le d,\ \tau(\mathbf G)\le\tau\}\).
